---
title: "North Carolina"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

senate_results <- read_tsv("data/north-carolina/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  group_by(County, Choice, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarize(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(County) |>
  slice_max(votes, n = 1) |>
  mutate(subregion = tolower(County))

nc_counties <- map_data("county") |>
  filter(region == "north carolina") |>
  left_join(senate_results, by = "subregion")

ggplot(nc_counties, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = Choice)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Roy Cooper" = "#2b83ba", "Michael Whatley" = "#d7191c")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "North Carolina US Senate Race (2026)",
    subtitle = "Winning candidate by county",
    fill = "Candidate"
  )
```
